doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

title: Jeanette Stokes and her family's move uptown
summary: Russell tries to recall Tom's sister-in-law Jeanette's maiden name. Martin confirms it was Stokes and says the family moved uptown from the Algiers side when small.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
